quranTranslation.text: (It is) of the awful tidings,

explanation.bs: „…o onoj velikoj vijesti (النَّبَإِ الْعَظِيمِ)“ – vijest o proživljenju.
explanation.en: “(It is) of the awful tidings” — the tidings of the Resurrection.

quranTranslation.text: But he was not long in coming, and he said: I have found out (a thing) that thou apprehendest not, and I come unto thee from Sheba with sure tidings.

explanation.bs: Pupavac: „i došao sam ti iz Sebe s pouzdanom vijesti (بِنَبَإٍ يَقِينٍ)“ – vijest koja donosi sigurno znanje.
explanation.en: The hoopoe: “I come unto thee from Sheba with sure tidings” (بِنَبَإٍ يَقِينٍ) — news that brings sure knowledge.

quranTranslation.text: O ye who believe! If an evil-liver bring you tidings, verify it, lest ye smite some folk in ignorance and afterward repent of what ye did.

explanation.bs: „Ako vam grešnik donese vijest, provjerite je“ – i važnu vijest treba provjeriti.
explanation.en: “If an evil-liver bring you tidings, verify it” — even weighty news must be checked.

quranTranslation.text: (Remember) when Moses said unto his household: Lo! I spy afar off a fire; I will bring you tidings thence, or bring to you a borrowed flame that ye may warm yourselves.

explanation.bs: Musa porodici: „donijet ću vam odande kakvu vijest (بِخَبَرٍ)“ – obična vijest o putu.
explanation.en: Moses to his family: “I will bring you tidings thence” (بِخَبَرٍ) — ordinary news about the way.

quranTranslation.text: That day she will relate her chronicles,

explanation.bs: „Tog dana ona će kazivati svoje vijesti“ – zemlja govori o onome što se na njoj činilo.
explanation.en: “That day she will relate her chronicles” — the earth tells what was done upon it.

quranTranslation.text: And verily We shall try you till We know those of you who strive hard (for the cause of Allah) and the steadfast, and till We test your record.

explanation.bs: „…i iskušat ćemo vijesti o vama“ – أَخْبَار kao ono što se o ljudima zna.
explanation.en: “…and till We test your record” — أَخْبَار as what is known of people.

quranTranslation.text: And if misfortune touch a man he crieth unto Us, (while reclining) on his side, or sitting or standing, but when We have relieved him of the misfortune he goeth his way as though he had not cried unto Us because of a misfortune that afflicted him. Thus is what they do made (seeming) fair unto the prodigal.

explanation.bs: „A kad čovjeka dotakne nevolja, on Nas zaziva … a kad mu otklonimo nevolju, on prođe kao da Nas nije ni zazivao“ – nevolja i zaborav nakon nje.
explanation.en: “And if misfortune touch a man he crieth unto Us … but when We have relieved him of the misfortune he goeth his way as though he had not cried unto Us” — adversity, and forgetting after it.

quranTranslation.text: Then We heard his prayer and removed that adversity from which he suffered, and We gave him his household (that he had lost) and the like thereof along with them, a mercy from Our store, and a remembrance for the worshippers;

explanation.bs: „Pa smo mu uslišali molbu i uklonili nevolju koja ga je bila snašla“ – ar-Rāġib: Ejjubova nevolja može obuhvatiti sve tri vrste.
explanation.en: “Then We heard his prayer and removed that adversity from which he suffered” — ar-Rāġib: Job's adversity may cover all three kinds.

quranTranslation.text: If Allah touch thee with affliction, there is none that can relieve therefrom save Him, and if He touch thee with good fortune (there is none that can impair it); for He is Able to do all things.

explanation.bs: „Ako te Allah dotakne nevoljom, nema nikoga ko bi je otklonio osim Njega.“
explanation.en: “If Allah touch thee with affliction, there is none that can relieve therefrom save Him.”

quranTranslation.text: They will not harm you save a trifling hurt, and if they fight against you they will turn and flee. And afterward they will not be helped.

explanation.bs: „Neće vam naškoditi, osim što će vas malo uznemiriti (أَذًى)“ – ar-Rāġib: malo će vas od njih pogoditi.
explanation.en: “They will not harm you save a trifling hurt (أَذًى)” — ar-Rāġib: little will reach you from them.

quranTranslation.text: O ye who believe! Render not vain your almsgiving by reproach and injury, like him who spendeth his wealth only to be seen of men and believeth not in Allah and the Last Day. His likeness is as the likeness of a rock whereon is dust of earth; a rainstorm smiteth it, leaving it smooth and bare. They have no control of aught of that which they have gained. Allah guideth not the disbelieving folk.

explanation.bs: „Ne poništavajte svoje sadake prigovaranjem i vrijeđanjem (الْأَذَى)“ – povreda riječima.
explanation.en: “Render not vain your almsgiving by reproach and injury (الْأَذَى)” — hurt by words.

quranTranslation.text: They question thee (O Muhammad) concerning menstruation. Say: It is an illness, so let women alone at such times and go not in unto them till they are cleansed. And when they have purified themselves, then go in unto them as Allah hath enjoined upon you. Truly Allah loveth those who turn unto Him, and loveth those who have a care for cleanness.

explanation.bs: „Pitaju te o mjesečnici. Reci: To je tegoba (أَذًى)“ – ar-Rāġib: po šerijatu i po medicini.
explanation.en: “They question thee (O Muhammad) concerning menstruation. Say: It is an illness (أَذًى)” — ar-Rāġib: by the Sharia and by medicine.

quranTranslation.text: And when it is said unto them: Come unto that which Allah hath revealed and unto the messenger, thou seest the hypocrites turn from thee with aversion.

explanation.bs: „Vidiš licemjere kako se od tebe odlučno odvraćaju“ – ar-Rāġib: okretanje sebe, odbijanje.
explanation.en: “Thou seest the hypocrites turn from thee with aversion” — ar-Rāġib: turning oneself away, refusing.

quranTranslation.text: I found her and her people worshipping the sun instead of Allah; and Satan maketh their works fairseeming unto them, and debarreth them from the way (of Truth), so that they go not aright;

explanation.bs: „Šejtan im je uljepšao njihova djela i odvratio ih od puta“ – odvraćanje drugih.
explanation.en: “Satan maketh their works fairseeming unto them, and debarreth them from the way (of Truth)” — turning others away.

quranTranslation.text: Satan seeketh only to cast among you enmity and hatred by means of strong drink and games of chance, and to turn you from remembrance of Allah and from (His) worship. Will ye then have done?

explanation.bs: Šejtan želi „da vas odvrati od spominjanja Allaha i od namaza“ – odvraćanje od cilja.
explanation.en: Satan seeketh “to turn you from remembrance of Allah and from (His) worship” — turning away from a goal.

quranTranslation.text: Yet refuse small kindnesses!

explanation.bs: „I uskraćuju sitnu pomoć (الْمَاعُونَ)“ – ar-Rāġib navodi ovaj ajet za suprotnost davanju.
explanation.en: “Yet refuse small kindnesses (الْمَاعُونَ)!” — ar-Rāġib cites this ayah for the opposite of giving.

quranTranslation.text: And who doth greater wrong than he who forbiddeth the approach to the sanctuaries of Allah lest His name should be mentioned therein, and striveth for their ruin. As for such, it was never meant that they should enter them except in fear. Theirs in the world is ignominy and theirs in the Hereafter is an awful doom.

explanation.bs: „A ko je veći nasilnik od onoga ko u Allahovim mesdžidima brani da se spominje Njegovo ime?“
explanation.en: “And who doth greater wrong than he who forbiddeth the approach to the sanctuaries of Allah lest His name should be mentioned therein”

quranTranslation.text: He said: What hindered thee that thou didst not fall prostrate when I bade thee? (Iblis) said: I am better than him. Thou createdst me of fire while him Thou didst create of mud.

explanation.bs: „Šta te je spriječilo da padneš na sedždu kad sam ti naredio?“ – Allahovo pitanje Iblisu.
explanation.en: “What hindered thee that thou didst not fall prostrate when I bade thee?” — Allah's question to Iblis.

quranTranslation.text: Say: Who hath forbidden the adornment of Allah which He hath brought forth for His bondmen, and the good things of His providing? Say: Such, on the Day of Resurrection, will be only for those who believed during the life of the world. Thus do we detail Our revelations for people who have knowledge.

explanation.bs: „Ko je zabranio ukras Allahov, koji je On za Svoje robove izveo?“ – ar-Rāġib: shvaćen je kao vanjski ukras (odjeća), a neki kažu da je to plemenitost (كَرَم).
explanation.en: “Who hath forbidden the adornment of Allah which He hath brought forth for His bondmen?” — ar-Rāġib: it has been taken as external adornment (clothing); others say it is nobility (كَرَم).

quranTranslation.text: Wealth and children are an ornament of the life of the world. But the good deeds which endure are better in thy Lord's sight for reward, and better in respect of hope.

explanation.bs: „Imetak i sinovi ukras su dunjalučkog života“ – ukras koji prolazi.
explanation.en: “Wealth and children are an ornament of the life of the world” — adornment that passes.

quranTranslation.text: Then went he forth before his people in his pomp. Those who were desirous of the life of the world said: Ah, would that we had the like of what hath been given unto Korah! Lo! he is lord of rare good fortune.

explanation.bs: Karun „izađe pred svoj narod u svom ukrasu“ – ar-Rāġib: ovosvjetski ukras, imetak i ugled.
explanation.en: Qārūn came out “before his people in his pomp” — ar-Rāġib: worldly adornment, wealth and standing.

quranTranslation.text: Thus have We appointed unto every prophet an adversary - devils of humankind and jinn who inspire in one another plausible discourse through guile. If thy Lord willed, they would not do so; so leave them alone with their devising;

explanation.bs: Šejtani jedni drugima „ubacuju kićen govor (زُخْرُفَ الْقَوْلِ), radi obmane“ – sjaj bez istine.
explanation.en: Devils “inspire in one another plausible discourse (زُخْرُفَ الْقَوْلِ) through guile” — glitter without truth.

quranTranslation.text: Or thou have a house of gold; or thou ascend up into heaven, and even then we will put no faith in thine ascension till thou bring down for us a book that we can read. Say (O Muhammad): My Lord be Glorified! Am I aught save a mortal messenger?

explanation.bs: Nevjernici traže od Poslanika „kuću od zlata“ – ar-Rāġib: od ukrašenog zlata.
explanation.en: The disbelievers demand of the Prophet “a house of gold” — ar-Rāġib: of ornamented gold.

quranTranslation.text: And ornaments of gold. Yet all that would have been but a provision of the life of the world. And the Hereafter with your Lord would have been for those who keep from evil.

explanation.bs: „I zlata. A sve to nije ništa drugo do uživanje u dunjalučkom životu.“
explanation.en: “And ornaments of gold. Yet all that would have been but a provision of the life of the world.”

quranTranslation.text: And We said: O Adam! Dwell thou and thy wife in the Garden, and eat ye freely (of the fruits) thereof where ye will; but come not nigh this tree lest ye become wrong-doers.

explanation.bs: „O Ademe, nastani se ti i tvoja supruga (زَوْج) u Džennetu“ – ista riječ za ženu; ar-Rāġib navodi ovaj ajet.
explanation.en: “O Adam! Dwell thou and thy wife (زَوْج) in the Garden” — the same word for a wife; ar-Rāġib cites this ayah.

quranTranslation.text: And all things We have created by pairs, that haply ye may reflect.

explanation.bs: „I od svake stvari stvorili smo par (زَوْجَيْنِ)“ – prema ar-Rāġibu, sve ima suprotnost, sličnost ili sastav, a samo je Allah Jedan.
explanation.en: “And all things We have created by pairs (زَوْجَيْنِ)” — according to ar-Rāġib, everything has an opposite, a like or a composition, and Allah alone is the One.

quranTranslation.text: Who hath appointed the earth as a bed and hath threaded roads for you therein and hath sent down water from the sky and thereby We have brought forth divers kinds of vegetation,

explanation.bs: „…i njome smo izveli razne vrste (أَزْوَاج) bilja“ – prema ar-Rāġibu, vrste.
explanation.en: “… and thereby We have brought forth divers kinds (أَزْوَاج) of vegetation” — according to ar-Rāġib, kinds.

quranTranslation.text: She said: Oh woe is me! Shall I bear a child when I am an old woman, and this my husband is an old man? Lo! this is a strange thing!

explanation.bs: Ibrahimova žena: „Zar ću ja roditi, a starica sam, i ovaj moj muž (بَعْل) je starac?“ – ar-Rāġib navodi ovaj ajet.
explanation.en: Abraham's wife: “Shall I bear a child when I am an old woman, and this my husband (بَعْل) is an old man?” — ar-Rāġib cites this ayah.

quranTranslation.text: Women who are divorced shall wait, keeping themselves apart, three (monthly) courses. And it is not lawful for them that they should conceal that which Allah hath created in their wombs if they are believers in Allah and the Last Day. And their husbands would do better to take them back in that case if they desire a reconciliation. And they (women) have rights similar to those (of men) over them in kindness, and men are a degree above them. Allah is Mighty, Wise.

explanation.bs: „A njihovi muževi (بُعُولَة) imaju više prava da ih u tom razdoblju vrate“ – množina; ar-Rāġib navodi ovaj ajet.
explanation.en: “And their husbands (بُعُولَة) would do better to take them back in that case” — the plural; ar-Rāġib cites this ayah.

quranTranslation.text: Will ye cry unto Baal and forsake the Best of creators,

explanation.bs: Ilijas svom narodu: „Zar Baala (بَعْل) prizivate, a ostavljate najboljeg Stvoritelja?“ – prema ar-Rāġibu, ime za ono što se smatralo nadređenim.
explanation.en: Elias to his people: “Will ye cry unto Baal (بَعْل) and forsake the Best of creators” — according to ar-Rāġib, a name for what was held to stand above.

quranTranslation.text: The seven heavens and the earth and all that is therein praise Him, and there is not a thing but hymneth His praise; but ye understand not their praise. Lo! He is ever Clement, Forgiving.

explanation.bs: „… ali vi ne razumijete njihovo slavljenje“ – sve stvoreno slavi Allaha, na način koji ne poimamo; ar-Rāġib navodi ovaj ajet.
explanation.en: “… but ye understand not their praise” — all things glorify Allah, in a way we do not grasp; ar-Rāġib cites this ayah.

quranTranslation.text: All that is in the heavens and the earth glorifieth Allah; and He is the Mighty, the Wise.

explanation.bs: „Allaha slavi sve što je na nebesima i na Zemlji …“ – slavljenje svega stvorenog, kako Njemu priliči.
explanation.en: “All that is in the heavens and the earth glorifieth Allah” — the glorifying of all creation, as befits Him.

quranTranslation.text: And when Saul set out with the army, he said: Lo! Allah will try you by (the ordeal of) a river. Whosoever therefore drinketh thereof he is not of me, and whosoever tasteth it not he is of me, save him who taketh (thereof) in the hollow of his hand. But they drank thereof, all save a few of them. And after he had crossed (the river), he and those who believed with him, they said: We have no power this day against Goliath and his hosts. But those who knew that they would meet Allah exclaimed: How many a little company hath overcome a mighty host by Allah's leave! Allah is with the steadfast.

explanation.bs: „… Allah će vas staviti na kušnju rijekom – onaj ko iz nje pije ne pripada meni …“ – rijeka na zemlji, Talutova kušnja.
explanation.en: “Lo! Allah will try you by (the ordeal of) a river. Whosoever therefore drinketh thereof he is not of me” — a river on earth, Saul's test.

quranTranslation.text: A similitude of the Garden which those who keep their duty (to Allah) are promised: Therein are rivers of water unpolluted, and rivers of milk whereof the flavour changeth not, and rivers of wine delicious to the drinkers, and rivers of clear-run honey; therein for them is every kind of fruit, with pardon from their Lord. (Are those who enjoy all this) like those who are immortal in the Fire and are given boiling water to drink so that it teareth their bowels?

explanation.bs: „… u njemu su rijeke vode koja se ne kvari i rijeke mlijeka čiji okus ostaje isti …“ – džennetske rijeke.
explanation.en: “Therein are rivers of water unpolluted, and rivers of milk whereof the flavour changeth not” — the rivers of the Garden.

quranTranslation.text: And when Moses asked for water for his people, We said: Smite with thy staff the rock. And there gushed out therefrom twelve springs (so that) each tribe knew their drinking-place. Eat and drink of that which Allah hath provided, and do not act corruptly, making mischief in the earth.

explanation.bs: „… i iz nje je provrelo dvanaest izvora, pa je svako pleme poznavalo mjesto svog napajanja …“ – izvori iz stijene koju je Musa udario štapom.
explanation.en: “And there gushed out therefrom twelve springs (so that) each tribe knew their drinking-place” — springs from the rock Moses struck with his staff.

quranTranslation.text: A spring wherefrom the slaves of Allah drink, making it gush forth abundantly,

explanation.bs: „Izvor iz kojeg piju Allahovi robovi, puštajući ga da obilno teče“ – džennetski izvor.
explanation.en: “A spring wherefrom the slaves of Allah drink, making it gush forth abundantly” — a spring of the Garden.

quranTranslation.text: Hast thou not seen how Allah hath sent down water from the sky and hath caused it to penetrate the earth as watersprings, and afterward thereby produceth crops of divers hues; and afterward they wither and thou seest them turn yellow; then He maketh them chaff. Lo! herein verily is a reminder for men of understanding.

explanation.bs: „Zar ne vidiš: Allah sa neba šalje vodu i uvodi je u tlo kao vrela …“ – ar-Rāġib navodi ovaj ajet; Allahovo djelo, kako Njemu priliči.
explanation.en: “Hast thou not seen how Allah hath sent down water from the sky and hath caused it to penetrate the earth as watersprings” — ar-Rāġib cites this ayah; Allah's act, as befits Him.

quranTranslation.text: And they say: We will not put faith in thee till thou cause a spring to gush forth from the earth for us;

explanation.bs: „… nećemo ti vjerovati dok nam iz zemlje ne izvedeš vrelo da provre“ – zahtjev nevjernika; arapska riječ je yanbūʿ, vrelo koje izbija.
explanation.en: “And they say: We will not put faith in thee till thou cause a spring to gush forth from the earth for us” — the disbelievers' demand; the Arabic word is yanbūʿ, a wellspring bursting out.
